actions.title: Reversal of Pentagon DEI Programs
actions.description: Eliminated diversity, equity, and inclusion offices across all military branches, removing training programs and advisory positions.
actions.summary: Dismantled DEI infrastructure within Department of Defense affecting 1.4M active duty and civilian personnel.

sources.title: Pentagon eliminates DEI offices in sweeping policy change

actions.department: Department of Health and Human Services
actions.title: FDA Vaccine Safety Review Initiative
actions.description: Ordered comprehensive review of all vaccine approvals since 2000, suspending new vaccine authorizations pending review completion.
actions.summary: Initiated sweeping vaccine safety review affecting all Americans, raising concerns among public health officials.

sources.title: HHS orders FDA vaccine review amid safety concerns

actions.title: Rollback of Clean Water Protections
actions.description: Repealed Obama-era Waters of the United States (WOTUS) rule, reducing federal oversight of wetlands and streams.
actions.summary: Removed federal protections for millions of acres of wetlands, affecting drinking water sources for 117 million Americans.

sources.title: EPA rolls back Clean Water Act protections

actions.title: ICE Hiring Surge and Border Patrol Expansion
actions.description: Authorized hiring of 10,000 additional ICE and Border Patrol agents, with expedited training programs.
actions.summary: Massive expansion of immigration enforcement workforce targeting undocumented immigrants.

actions.title: Federal Student Loan Forgiveness Program Termination
actions.description: Cancelled Public Service Loan Forgiveness and income-driven repayment plans, affecting borrowers mid-program.
actions.summary: Eliminated student debt relief programs, leaving millions of borrowers without promised forgiveness.

sources.title: Education Dept. ends student loan forgiveness programs

actions.title: Expansion of Oil and Gas Leasing on Federal Lands
actions.description: Opened previously protected federal lands including national monuments for oil and gas drilling lease auctions.
actions.summary: Rolled back conservation protections, prioritizing fossil fuel extraction on public lands.

sources.title: Interior opens protected lands to drilling

actions.title: Overtime Eligibility Rule Revision
actions.description: Raised salary threshold for overtime eligibility from $35,568 to $55,000, expanding overtime protections.
actions.summary: Expanded overtime pay protections for 4.2 million workers, requiring employers to compensate more workers for overtime hours.

actions.title: Termination of Civil Rights Division Consent Decrees
actions.description: Withdrew from police reform consent decrees in over 40 jurisdictions, ending federal oversight of police departments.
actions.summary: Ended federal police oversight programs established after civil rights violations, affecting residents in major cities.

sources.title: DOJ ends police reform agreements nationwide

actions.title: Renewable Energy Research Funding Cuts
actions.description: Slashed Department of Energy renewable energy and climate research budgets by 75%, redirecting funds to fossil fuel research.
actions.summary: Gutted clean energy research programs, eliminating thousands of research positions and halting climate initiatives.

sources.title: Energy Dept. eliminates renewable energy programs
